[ISTS.2.3] **Public-API gap rule.** If a spec test needs
something that isn't in `libds.h`, that's a public-API gap to close in
the header, or a sign that the test arranges state no integrator can
reach — never a reason to escape the discipline ([ISTS.2.2]).

A spec test arranges an engine as an integrator does. A schema reaches an
engine only from a compiled artefact ([NFCT.1.1]), so a spec test
that needs one must declare it in DS source, compile it with the build's
compiler and load the artefact with `ds_engine_load_dsc`, which
`spec_common.h`'s `spec_load_ds` does. It must not register a schema
through an internal entry point. A spec test whose subject is a function
that leaves `libds.h` leaves with it.

Each gap found is a small public-API addition, and they accumulate into a
complete integrator surface.
